verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੁ ਤਿਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਾਈਅਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਭਸਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tin tin mel jaise chhaan chhaieeat pun agan pragaas taas bhasam karat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a hut is built putting each straw and twig together but fire raises it to the ground in no time.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਧ ਕੇ ਕਿਨਾਰੇ ਬਾਲੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰਚਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਉਮਗਿ ਭਏ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: si(n)dh ke kinaare baaloo gireh baalak rachat jaise lahar umag bhe dheer na dharat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as children make houses of sand on the sea-shore, but with one wave of water all of them collapse and merge with the sand around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਏਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਗਾਜੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ban bikhai mil baiThat anek mirag ek miragaraaj gaaje rahio na parat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as many animals like deer etc. sit together but with one roar of the lion who comes there, all of them run away,

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਗਲ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੧॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT sabadh ar surat dhiaan giaan pragaTe pooran prem sagal rahat hai ||531||

en.bdb: Similarly focusing of eyesight at a point, reciting an incantation repeatedly and absorbing the mind in many ways of meditation and contemplations and many other forms of spiritual practices collapse like mud walls with the emergence of complete love of the True Guru.  (531)
